summary: Iteration 2 focused on new features: admin Reports (Laporan), CSV/PDF export, PUT /api/me/profile (whatsapp_number), and Telegram /laporan command. Extended backend_test.py from 32 to 42 pytest cases; all 42 pass sequentially. Reports endpoint validated for days=7/30/90 with correct structure (totals bookings/returned/overdue/items/users, top_items, top_users, late_users, trend). Full booking cycle (create→approve→return→confirm) reflected correctly in reports totals (bookings+1, returned+1, top_items/top_users updated). CSV export returns text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment=laporan-30hari.csv and headers Booking,Peminjam,Barang,Mulai,Selesai,Status,Dikembalikan,Terlambat. RBAC verified: user (ghozy) receives 403 on /admin/reports and /admin/reports/export. PUT /me/profile persists whatsapp_number and GET /auth/me reflects it. On booking event, WHATSAPP notification recorded in /admin/notifications-log with simulated=true (expected, creds empty). Telegram /laporan command accepted (200 ok). Frontend UI: admin dashboard Laporan tab shows all 4 stat cards, trend LineChart, top-items BarChart, top-users, late-users panels; range 7/30/90 buttons update data; Export CSV and Export PDF trigger downloads (laporan-90hari.csv, laporan-90hari.pdf). All 6 other admin tabs (approval/peminjaman/akses/inventaris/log/pengaturan) still load. User notifications page has whatsapp-number-input + save-whatsapp-button, save persists value round-trip. Regression: booking create, double-booking prevention, maintenance-blocks-booking, approve/reject, request-return/confirm-return, Telegram webhook (secret + approve callback + /laporan) all green.
critical_code_review_comments: services.build_report uses `overdue` counter which increments for any late booking (STATUS_OVERDUE or returned_at > end_time). This double-counts late RETURNED bookings AND active OVERDUE. Consider naming clarity (currently exposed as totals.overdue which conflates 'late total' with 'currently overdue'). UI label 'Terlambat' is fine for it, but be aware it differs from /admin/stats.overdue which is only currently-OVERDUE status. If chart is meant to show currently-overdue, semantics may confuse admins.
services.build_report loads all bookings then all items into memory — fine now (small dataset) but should be aggregated in Mongo for scale.

In test suite parallel run with pytest-xdist causes item availability contention (many parallel bookings on same item). backend_test.py should ideally reuse an admin-created item per test or use unique items — sequential run (no xdist) currently required for repeatable green.

server.py telegram_webhook: /laporan does not enforce secret if TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_IDS is empty; ok because secret is required by outer check, but callbacks from non-admin chats are correctly rejected only when TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_IDS is set (previous test in iter1 relied on empty admin_ids, now correctly restricted).
Providers WhatsApp Meta Cloud: when creds empty, sim mode returns simulated=True — behaviour verified. No leakage of tokens.

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed bookings created during tests. Cleaned up (12 removed) before final run; some remain from the final run (7 bookings visible on 30d report). Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest sequentially (avoid xdist -n auto or set -o addopts='') because tests share the same live Mongo and parallel workers can starve item availability. Use `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts='' -v`. Frontend routes: /admin (admin dashboard tabs including Laporan), /notifikasi (user notification page with whatsapp input), /peminjaman, /barang/<id>. Export PDF uses browser jsPDF (client-side); download event fires with filename laporan-<days>hari.pdf. WhatsApp / Google Calendar / Tuya / Meta Cloud all run in SIMULASI mode (creds empty) — expected. Telegram bot is LIVE; be careful with /laporan and callback tests to avoid spamming the real group.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration 2 acceptance criteria pass.
